what_happened: Scene: layout 9 (dark-blue cabinets; same kitchen as s0/s2/s3/s13/s18/s26), 5-burner gas hob; pan_7 (rusty cast iron, integrated handle) in the high upper cabinet; target front_right; drumstick on a plate right of the hob. Stage 0: the fingers took the handle right at its junction with the pan body (wrist 84-128: handle running from the pan toward the camera between the fingers; width only ~0.06 because the handle is thick), the pan was carried flat, and released at 311 on front_right (0.073 m). Stage 0 complete 321 (fast). Stage 1: drumstick grasped at 383 (lift 0.16 m), released into the pan at 441. Stage 2: knob contact from 526; the task knob front_right was on (0.6 rad) by 564-576 and reached 1.5 rad by 640, but the gripper stayed at the knob, within 25 cm of the drumstick, until ~785; the official success fired only at 805. So stage 2 shows 364 steps (p90 369) although the burner was on after ~123.
official_criterion_notes: The gripper-far-from-meat clause delayed the success by ~240 steps (task burner on from 564, success 805) because the knob row is within 25 cm of the meat in the pan. The packet's close_events miss the pan grasp at ~90 (width fell only to ~0.06 on the thick cast-iron handle); only the 526 close is listed.
